text_block_list.text:
While walking along the riverbank, I spotted
Yaeno Muteki and Bamboo Memory.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: "Aaalright! Are you ready for this, Yaeno?!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Aye! Bring on whatever you have!

And then, Bamboo Memory calmly raised
her shinai... taking a high-ready stance!
Could this be... a duel!?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Cheeeeryaaaaaaah!!!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Gasp!!!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
—Oh! Was that the blade-catching technique?!
So cool! Flawlessly done, ssir!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer!
I was just getting in a bit of sparring with Yaeno!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno spars with me once in a while like this!
Doing kendo really sharpens your focus even more, after all!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes. And having both practiced the martial arts since childhood,
there is much we can share and understand.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo-san is, so to speak, a bosom friend.
When we train together, it truly feels like
we share an inseparable bond of "fish and water."

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Tiki-tiki boiled gyoza, right?!

...Regardless, I decided to just watch over their training.
However, after a little while, just as I was about to head home—

text_block_list.name: Kitten
text_block_list.text: —Meow. Meoow...!

Looking toward the voice, I saw a kitten pacing in front of a small ditch.
It seemed unable to make up its mind to jump, but—
choice_data_list: ...I wonder if it's trying to jump over?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Hauah!? T-That's dangerous!
If you were to fall and drown...!
I will prot—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: "—No! We can't mess with that!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Bamboo-san... For what reason?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"...Look across the canal, ssuka.
There's been a cat intently watching us over there for a while now, ain't there?"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
That's definitely the mama cat.
She crossed over first to teach the kitten
how to jump, see?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
If we step in, we'll just be robbin' that kitten
of its power to survive on its own, boss!
We gotta hold back and just watch over it, boss!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: B-But...! If that's the case, couldn't we at least let her practice somewhere a little safer...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...It's kind of like a trial given by a mother cat.
I believe that kitten will overcome that huge wall
and grow from it, you know?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Besides... even if it doesn't work out,
there's no need to worry!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno and I are keeping watch!
There's no way we'd let that kitten drown before we can rescue it!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Bamboo-san...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Gnuuuggghhh!!
U-Understood!!
Though it breaks my heart... I'll believe in her growth!
And—
The kitten made a magnificent leap across the canal and safely reached its mother!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Oh! That proud look on the kitten's face...!
Ah, truly precious...! What a relief...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"...It was just as you said.
Watching over them was the best course...
I have the utmost respect for your keen insight, Bamboo-san."

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Man, I grew up listening to all sorts of moral lessons from my mom! Doing everything for someone isn't always the best thing to do!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"This is what they call, um...
'A lion sends its cubs on errands alone'!
...Right?!"

The proverb was slightly off...
but thanks to Bamboo Memory's judgment, the little kitten
has undeniably taken a step closer to becoming a proud "lion."
choice_data_list: You've helped that kitten's heart grow.
You've helped that kitten's heart grow, haven't you.
Since we're here, wanna play with the cat for a bit?
Since we have some time, do you want to play with the cat for a bit?

text_block_list.text:

but thanks to Bamboo Memory's judgment, the little kitten

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yes, sir! But man, that's incredible!
She cleared a river twice her size!
I really need to take a page out of her book!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, I know! Let's follow her lead
and take on a huge trial ourselves!
How about we climb that bridge pillar over there!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Indeed! Let us muster even greater courage!
—Regardless, it was a moment where I caught a glimpse of a slightly different side to the two look-alikes.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Totally! Then how about
a cat toy or somethin'—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Ah, ah, the mother cat is grooming them!?
Like she's telling her kitten "good job"...!?
Haaah! I-I want to p-pwotect them...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Y-Yaeno!? Are you listening?
Your overprotective habit is acting up again!"
—Regardless, it was a moment where I caught a glimpse of a slightly different side to the two look-alikes.
